title: Knowledge bible file (.fleet/kb-canonical.json)
description: The bible file written by kb_export and kb_bible_commit and read by kb_import and the member bible view. Writers emit format v3. Readers accept v1 (a bare array of entries), v2 (the envelope, no per-entry hashes) and v3 (the envelope; entries may carry source_file_hashes). See spec.md section 2.8. Hand-authored: the bible is a file format, not a tool request/response, so it is not generated from a Zod schema and does not live under schemas/.

anyOf.title: v1 (legacy): a bare array of entries
v2: envelope, entries carry no hash basis
v3: envelope, entries may carry source_file_hashes

provenance.description: commit: the base commit the entries were verified against (null when unknown). branch: the target base branch the entries merge into. entry_count: the number of entries in the file.

repoRelativePath.description: A path inside the repository: relative, no '..' segment, no POSIX, drive-letter or UNC root.

entry.description: One bible entry. Writers emit the stable field set below; a human-edited extra field on an entry already in the file is kept as-is, so extra properties are allowed.

source_file_hashes.description: v3 only: the per-file hash basis (repo-relative path -> hash) the entry was admitted against, copied verbatim (keys sorted) from the exporting KB's stored basis. Absent on an entry carried over from a v1/v2 bible. A reader stores a valid map (non-empty, covering every source_files entry) as the entry's basis exactly; anything else imports basis-less.
